basic_details.short_information: Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt. Hospital (ABGH), Government of N.C.T. of Delhi, Moti Nagar, New Delhi-110015 will conduct a walk-in interview on 27 October 2026 (Tuesday) between 9:30 A.M. to 11:00 A.M. reporting time at the Conference Room, ABGH, for 4 adhoc vacancies of Senior Resident in Gynae, Paeds, and Medicine departments at 7th CPC pay matrix level 11 (Rs 67,700/- - Rs 2,08,700/-).

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: Maximum age is 45 years as on date of interview as per order no. F.No.DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy. (H&FW) CD No. #11245062/1502-08 dated 26-11-2020. Age limit is relaxable by 05 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC Candidates.

content_sections.heading: Tenure and Conditions of Service
content_sections.text: For Adhoc candidates, period will be 89 days extendable for a maximum period of three years, including the Ad-hoc period or till the joining of Regular/Specialist Doctors whichever is earlier. If UR candidates are selected against reserved category their tenure will be of 44 (Forty Four) days which may be extended on the basis of Good/Very Good/Excellent Work and Conduct from working department on 44 (Forty Four) days basis with a break day maximum upto 03 years. SRs are appointed for maximum period of 3 years, including previous experience, if any. The service will stand automatically terminated on joining of a regular candidate.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: On 27 October 2026, the selection process follows these steps: Applicants must report in Room No. 304, Establishment Branch, 3rd floor, ABG hospital, Delhi between 9:30 A.M. and 10:30 A.M. positively to mark their attendance. Reporting and registration in the Conference Room, ABGH takes place from 9:30 A.M. to 11:00 A.M. Members of the Selection Board / interview board scrutinise, check, and verify the submitted application and self-attested documents against the original certificates. Interviews commence at 11:30 A.M. in the Conference Room, ABGH. The mode of selection will be through interview only. In case the number of applications is very high, the interview may be continued on the next working days, which will be communicated verbally by Board Members to candidates on the interview date at closing time without separate communication.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ABGH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 27 October 2026 (Tuesday) from 11:30 A.M. onwards, with reporting between 9:30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the ABGH Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview venue is the Conference Room, ABGH, Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt. Hospital, Moti Nagar, New Delhi-110015, with attendance marked in Room No. 304, Establishment Branch, 3rd floor from 9:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in ABGH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 Senior Resident vacancies: 1 in Gynae (ST), 2 in Paeds (OBC), and 1 in Medicine (ST).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Resident at ABGH?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB/DIPLOMA or equivalent in concerned stream) OR 03 Years' Experience as Junior Resident with 02 Years in the concerned department, along with DMC registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ABGH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years as on the date of interview, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Senior Residents at ABGH?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive remuneration under 7th CPC pay matrix level 11 (Rs 67,700/- - Rs 2,08,700/-) along with other admissible allowances per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ABGH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The mode of selection is through walk-in interview only, followed by certificate verification and medical fitness examination by the Staff Physician of ABGH.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Senior Resident appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on an adhoc basis initially for 89 days, extendable up to a maximum period of three years including previous experience, or until a regular doctor joins.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states claim OBC reservation in ABGH Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, OBC and EWS certificates issued by the Government of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted, and OBC candidates must possess a valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for the current financial year.
